item.title: Gardiner '28: Georgia's attack on its universities should be a warning for Brown
item.description: On May 22, I was listening to music at the wryly named 1984 Jazz Club in Tbilisi, Georgia when I learned that President Trump had attempted to revoke Harvard's ability to enroll international students. Five months later, Georgia's government introduced a similar restriction on its own universities.I was in Georgia to study human rights and democratic backsliding under the country's increasingly autocratic government. What I did not expect is that these lessons would also become relevant at home.
